title: VIB-Probe: Detecting and Mitigating Hallucinations in Vision-Language Models via Variational Information Bottleneck
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical problem of 'hallucinations' in Vision-Language Models, defined as generated text that deviates from the visual content.
